# Recovered model training and pretraining handoff

**Repository:** biobitworks/dna-forge. This file inventories
IMPLEMENTED source code, EXECUTED training, OBSERVED results, and missing
artifacts separately. It is an append-only successor to PRs #15-#24.

## Were pathology foundation models trained from scratch?

**No.** Biobase supplied pretrained image feature vectors generated by
GigaPath, H-optimus-0, BiomedCLIP and DINOv2. We fitted lightweight
classifiers to these frozen features; the base encoders were NOT
fine-tuned and their pretrained weight files are NOT present in GitHub.

| Model | Code | Source | Verified use or result |
|---|---|---|---|
| GigaPath, H-optimus-0 | challenge-supplied vectors | pretrained encoders; no local base weights | Used for the final ens-svm |
| BiomedCLIP, DINOv2 | challenge-supplied vectors | pretrained encoders; no local base weights | Used in development sweeps and removals |
| Linear SVM, logistic regression, kNN | dnaforge/models.py | small fitted models on the labeled Biobase slide vectors | SVM winner, fit/replayed on two Macs |
| Attention MIL | dnaforge/mil.py | new lightweight PyTorch head over pretrained tile vectors | TRAINED; weaker than chosen SVM; NOT_PROMOTED |
| Stacked ensemble | dnaforge/stack.py | meta-classifier over out-of-fold model outputs | TESTED; NOT_PROMOTED |
| Task A reports | dnaforge/reports.py | manually authored parser and 30 rule predicates | NO fitted parameters; training F1 1.000 but not independent rule-development validation |
| Independent Patient selector | Patient selector/find_right_patients_code_and_app(1)/hack | separate app and baseline methods | SOURCE_PUSHED; separate results, not automatically merged with winning prediction files |
| Symptom endometriosis ML | dnaforge/endo.py | separate Kaggle source | CV AUC ~0.655; OFFICIAL_BIOBASE_NOT_APPLICABLE |
| HistAI gynecologic metadata | dnaforge/histai.py | CC BY-NC histology metadata | graph enrichment; NOT an independently validated PCOS classifier |

**No model-weight binaries** are tracked on current main. Reproduction
is achieved by refitting small classifiers with authorized, local input
features; do not misrepresent this as distributing full pretrained weights.

## Independent MagicPro and MagicStudio execution

Both machines trained/replayed the chosen ens-svm from clean commit
dda6c509815e0437171b15b0a76c6c64ee8856ae with Python 3.9.6,
NumPy 2.0.2, scikit-learn 1.6.1, SciPy 1.13.1 and the same fold SHA-256.
The five output-file SHA-256 digests were identical. This is reproducibility
of exact bytes, not independent clinical or hidden-test accuracy.
Receipts: docs/evidence/20261114_enssvm_crossnode_verified.json.
Protocol: notebooks/05_crossnode_enssvm_replay.ipynb.

**Development:** C1 OOF accuracy 0.8631578947368421;
C2 P@1/5/10 0.868421052631579 / 0.8294736842105263 / 0.8.
These are development cross-validation estimates, not confirmed official
hidden scores. The organizer baseline figures were not independently
re-evaluated here on identical folds.

## Local teammate reproduction

    git clone https://github.com/biobitworks/dna-forge.git
    cd dna-forge
    python3 -m venv .venv
    source .venv/bin/activate
    pip install -e '.[ml,dev]'
    python -m pytest -q tests
    python scripts/check_no_data.py

The following commands assume ROOT is a local authorized unpacked Biobase
pack, REPORT_PACK a local reports pack, and RUNS a separate restricted
destination. Do not overwrite the selected final files.

    python -m dnaforge --root "$ROOT" folds --out custody/local/folds.json --hash-out custody/local/folds.sha256
    diff custody/folds.sha256 custody/local/folds.sha256
    python -m dnaforge --root "$ROOT" --runs "$RUNS" submit --method ens-svm --alpha 3 --folds custody/local/folds.json
    python -m dnaforge.reports --pack "$REPORT_PACK" --runs-dir "$RUNS"

For alternative tile-attention training, requiring licensed local tile data:

    pip install '.[vision,ml]'
    python -m dnaforge.mil --root "$ROOT" --model hoptimus --runs "$RUNS"

## Negative evidence and missing orthogonal inputs

- Report rules were authored while inspecting the full labeled
  training set. Five-fold row-subset score 1.000 is stability, NOT
  independent generalization.
- Three of seven synthetic paraphrase perturbations broke task A
  predictions. This is robustness evidence, NOT official task A scores.
- Supplier-held-out slide evaluation drops notably, so OOF scores
  may not transfer to unseen suppliers.
- MIL models recorded development accuracies ~0.595 H-optimus,
  ~0.511 BiomedCLIP and ~0.379 DINOv2; NOT_PROMOTED.
- HistAI recovered gynecologic corpus includes only four PCOS-tagged
  cases in the referenced subset, inadequate for validated training.
- Kaggle endometriosis dataset licence UNKNOWN; HistAI source CC BY-NC.
  These sources are not admitted to official Biobase challenge training.
- Research literature on ovarian follicles, menstrual macrophages,
  endometriosis IHC and microchimerism offers PROPOSED evidence graph
  nodes, not usable supervised labels. Maternal microchimerism is a
  hypothesis; negative male fetal microchimerism is separate evidence.
